title: Apply the branch policy to the three subrepos
description: With the policy established in the root repo, apply it to helios, hills, and hyperspace: enable GitHub branch protection on each master (require a PR, no direct pushes), and add a short AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointer in each so an agent working inside a submodule sees the rule without reading the superproject. Requires gh auth.

title: Regenerate the stale helios coverage baseline and triage data
description: coverage/helios.json and coverage/helios.triage.json were measured against the deleted fork's Metal-ported code. The re-forked helios is at v2.1.1, pre-Metal, so both files describe code that no longer exists and the ratchet gate would compare against a meaningless baseline. Re-run ./tools/coverage.sh helios and ./tools/triage.sh helios against the new tree and commit fresh data.

title: Rewrite branch policy and re-pin helios to the re-forked remote
description: The root repo's branch policy (CLAUDE.md:74) contradicts its own session-completion checklist, which ends at 'git push' rather than at an opened PR. AGENTS.md omits the branch rule entirely. Separately, the helios fork was deleted and re-forked, leaving the submodule pinned to a dangling SHA. Establish the new process in the root repo and re-pin helios, all via a feature branch and PR.

title: Trim the coverage and triage skills to judgment only
description: Both SKILL.md files carry copies of data that lives authoritatively elsewhere, and both have already gone stale: coverage/SKILL.md says helios includes Helios.cpp (its config's _scope says the opposite), and triage/SKILL.md's Current state table predates the re-scope. Delete the derived content (flag tables duplicating --help, the scope paragraph duplicating _scope, the current-state tables duplicating the ledger) and keep only what a script cannot carry: the C-bucket argument, the calibration limits, the reporting guidance. Move the scope/baseline prohibitions into the scripts' failure output, since a skill is only loaded when the model chooses to load it and the guardrail is needed precisely when nobody asked.

title: Enforce the branch policy mechanically
description: Nothing currently prevents a commit on a default branch: .claude/settings.json has empty hooks, settings.local.json pre-approves 'git commit -m *' and 'git push *' with no branch guard, and there is no .github/ or CODEOWNERS in any of the four repos. Add a PreToolUse hook that refuses a commit or push when HEAD is the default branch, plus GitHub branch protection.

title: Redo the helios Metal port under the new process
description: The deleted fork carried a Metal port (v2.2.0, v2.2.1, and the origin/modernize branch) that is not on the re-forked remote and is not recoverable locally — there is no .git/modules/helios. Rebuild it from v2.1.1 as a series of feat/<topic> branches and PRs against helios master, then bump the superproject pointer in a separate PR.

title: Audit triage verdict precision on all three submodules
description: Run triage across helios, hills and hyperspace and hand-audit a sample of verdicts per submodule, with attention to the C bucket where a wrong verdict silently removes work from the queue. If the unknown rate is above roughly a third, the clang AST path stops being a contingency and becomes a requirement for the classifier.
close_reason: audited: 12/12 C and 10/10 A verdicts correct by hand-check; unknown rate 1/241 helios, 0/16 hills, 1/214 hyperspace -- far under the one-third bar, so the clang AST path stays a contingency. One false positive found and removed (c:dead-port misread a #else arm as dead)

title: Add triage front door: tools/triage.sh and the triage skill
description: tools/triage.sh drives the region export plus the classifier and prints the per-submodule verdict; .claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md is the front door, mirroring the coverage skill's discipline that the script is the logic. The skill must state that 100% is the wrong target, report the addressable ceiling, and forbid triage from editing coverage config scope.
close_reason: tools/triage.sh + .claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md landed; coverage skill cross-references it

title: Build triage classifier (rules + ledger)
description: tools/triage_classify.py turns the region export into A/B/C verdicts using a fixed-precedence deterministic rule table, writing coverage/<name>.triage.json keyed on path::signature. Anything the rules cannot decide is marked unknown and escalated to human/model judgment, which is then persisted so it is not re-litigated each run.
close_reason: classifier + ledger landed; rule table validated on all three submodules, 12/12 C and 10/10 A verdicts correct on hand-audit, dead-port rule removed as unfixable

title: Add --regions export to coverage.sh (null-driver path)
description: Triage needs llvm-cov's per-function region data, including when a submodule has no test drivers yet. Extend tools/coverage.sh with --regions FILE: synthesize a stub main when tests/ is empty, and run a full llvm-cov export instead of -summary-only. Reuses the existing config resolution, per-extension compile rules and framework linking so triage and the gate share one build path and one denominator.
close_reason: coverage.sh --regions lands with the null-driver path; verified on all three submodules (helios 241, hyperspace 214, hills 16 functions enumerated at 0%)

title: Write test drivers to arm the coverage gate
description: The coverage gate runs but reports 0% because no submodule has a tests/ directory. Add drivers under helios/tests, hyperspace/tests, hills/tests. Start with preference loading/clamping (proven crash source), then characterization tests on Implicit and rsMath before hyperspace is ported.

title: Coverage gate: tools/coverage.sh + /coverage skill
description: Ratchet-based code coverage gate for each submodule. Scope is the testable C++/ObjC core (AppKit/Metal excluded and documented). Built on clang -fprofile-instr-generate + llvm-cov export, not xcodebuild/xccov, because xcodebuild -list exits 70 on this machine (IDESimulatorFoundation plugin failure) and no .xcscheme files exist in any repo. Script lives in each submodule so their CI can run it standalone; parent holds the skill.

title: Add helios, hills, hyperspace as git submodules
description: The three screen saver projects are nested git repos sitting untracked in the parent repo. Register them as proper submodules pointing at their GitHub origins so the parent repo records pinned commits instead of ignoring them.

title: Decide hyperspace impCubeVolume::polygonize triage verdict
description: The classifier cannot isolate polygonize's body because #if USE_TRIANGLE_STRIPS splits the loop across preprocessor arms, so it sits in the ? bucket awaiting a human call. The identical function in helios was judged A. Record with: tools/triage.sh hyperspace --set 'impCubeVolume::polygonize(unsigned int)' --verdict A --reason '...'
